# NULL JSFX

> 133 professional audio plugins for Cockos Reaper. Minimal design, maximum precision. Free and open source.

## Overview
NULL JSFX is a suite of 133 audio plugins written in EEL2 for Cockos Reaper's JSFX platform. Organized into five categories: ONE SLIDER (single-control effects), ESSENTIALS (daily-use tools), ADVANCED (specialized processing), INSTRUMENTS (synths, keys, bass and drums played from MIDI) and MIDI (note tools placed before an instrument). Every plugin also ships as GFX JSFX (own interface, REAPER) as VST3/CLAP for any DAW on Windows, macOS and Linux, and as LV2 on Linux; every version sounds identical to the original JSFX. Extras: factory presets in every format, 73 REAPER FX chains, and the Rack (VST3/CLAP), which chains up to 8 NULL effects with band, Mid/Side and modulation routing.
